title: Queema Matar (Spicy Ground Beef with Peas)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Ground beef and peas, the author's lifelong comfort food, ideally eaten with khichri and coriander chutney or raita. Hard to ruin (except with too much salt), so it's a good base for experiments once made as written.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and fry, stirring, about 2 min, until the cumin darkens:
Add and fry, breaking up lumps, until browned and no longer pink (it will release water):
items: 1½ lb ground beef (700 g); lean for a drier queema

steps.action: Stir in; keep frying until the liquid is gone and the meat turns a deeper brown:
items: 2 tsp ground coriander (or 1 Tbsp whole coriander seeds, for crunch)
3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)

steps.action: Mix in; cover and cook 30 min, stirring every 10 min:
items: 4 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 10 cm), peeled, in ⅛ in (3 mm) dice

steps.action: Uncover; stir over high about 5 min, scraping the bottom, until darker and quite dry.
Stir in; cover, turn off heat, and rest 5 min:
items: 10 oz peas (280 g), fresh or frozen (optional)
Any rice, daal, vegetable, or bread
Whole coriander seeds, if used, are eaten
